question_en: Which companies led the most FL summaries under Agenda Item 7.1 (NR MIMO)? Top 5 (technical leadership).
original_query:
MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem), (t)-[:MODERATED_BY]->(c:Company)
WHERE ai.agendaNumber STARTS WITH '7.1' AND t.summaryType = 'FL'
RETURN c.companyName, count(t) AS flCount ORDER BY flCount DESC, c.companyName LIMIT 5

semantic_units.judgment: The English asks for five companies ranked by recorded FL-summary leadership. The preserved FL/Moderator definitions support a documentary company role; no causal or technical-superiority condition is added. flCount is the original ranking statistic.
semantic_units.assessment: Recorded company role and original top5 selection supported.
